import hashlib, json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from factoryline.graph_forensics import seal_graph_lineage
from factoryline.proofsearch import create_proofsearch_plan, evaluate_proofsearch
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
    root = Path(raw)
    step = {'sequence': 1, 'superstep': 0, 'node_id': 'build', 'checkpoint_id': 'cp', 'reads': [], 'writes': [], 'evidence': [], 'side_effects': [], 'decision': {'route': 'verify', 'reason': 'ready'}}
    a = root / 'a.json'
    b = root / 'b.json'
    a.write_text(json.dumps([step]))
    b.write_text(json.dumps([{**step, 'decision': {'route': 'repair', 'reason': 'failed'}}]))
    left = root / 'left.json'
    right = root / 'right.json'
    seal_graph_lineage('a', 'g', a, left)
    seal_graph_lineage('b', 'g', b, right)
    plan = root / 'plan.json'
    create_proofsearch_plan(root, left, right, ['src/a.py'], plan)

    def candidate(name, risk, killed):
        patch = root / f'{name}.patch'
        patch.write_text(name)
        receipt = root / f'{name}.proof.json'
        receipt.write_text('{}')
        sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        return {'candidate_id': name, 'patch': {'path': patch.name, 'sha256': sha(patch)}, 'changed_paths': ['src/a.py'], 'proofs': [{'name': 'unit', 'required': True, 'status': 'passed', 'receipt': {'path': receipt.name, 'sha256': sha(receipt)}, 'elapsed_ms': 10, 'tokens': None, 'cost_usd': None}], 'mutation': {'killed': killed, 'total': 1}, 'guardrails': {'weakens_tests': False, 'suppresses_errors': False, 'expands_scope': False}, 'risk_score': risk, 'changed_lines': risk}
    sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    request = root / 'request.json'
    request.write_text(json.dumps({'schema': 'factory.proofsearch-request.v1', 'plan': {'path': plan.name, 'sha256': sha(plan)}, 'candidates': [candidate('winner', 2, 1), candidate('hollow', 1, 0)]}))
    result = evaluate_proofsearch(root, request, root / 'evaluation.json')
    assert result['winner'] == 'winner'
    assert next((c for c in result['candidates'] if c['candidate_id'] == 'hollow'))['reasons'] == ['HOLLOW_CANDIDATE_TESTS']
    assert result['apply'] is False
print('PROOFSEARCH_SMOKE_PASS')
